title: Savoury Pumpkin and Parmesan Ravioli
changes_from_base: Drained tinned pumpkin cooked with onion, turmeric, sage, thyme and parmesan replaces the ricotta filling, and the round ravioli are finished simply with melted butter or olive oil.
summary: Golden ravioli filled with silky spiced pumpkin and parmesan, finished with a simple drizzle of butter.

ingredients.item: fresh egg pasta dough or sheets (shop-bought, or half a batch of homemade)
fine sea salt or table salt
large egg, beaten with 1 tbsp cold water, for sealing
fine sea salt or table salt, for the cooking water
melted butter or 30 ml olive oil, to serve

steps.title: Ready
steps.text: Leave 225 g pasta dough to sit at room temperature and put a large pot of water on to heat.

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Set 270 g pumpkin purée in a fine-mesh strainer over a bowl, lay cling film on top, weight it with a tin and leave 15-20 min so the extra liquid drips away.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Melt 28 g butter and cook 34 g onion until translucent, stir in ⅛ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp sage and ¼ tsp thyme for 1 min, then cook the pumpkin in the pan until hot and slightly drier.

steps.title: Bind
steps.text: Mix in 50 g parmesan, ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper, working in 1 tbsp potato starch if it looks loose, then let it cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Roll the pasta out on the next-to-last notch of the machine, dot small spoonfuls about 5 cm apart along one half, brush around each with egg beaten with 1 tbsp water, fold the other half over and press to seal.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Stamp out with a 5 cm cutter for 18-20 ravioli, pinching with a fork wherever a seal looks weak.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Lower into gently boiling, well-salted water and, once they rise, give them 2 min more.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scoop out with a slotted spoon, drizzle with 30 g melted butter or 30 ml olive oil and serve hot.

tips: Drain the purée without forcing it through the sieve so the filling stays firm, not watery.
Make the filling a day ahead and chill it, then let it return to room temperature before filling.
Cook the parcels right through, as both the pasta and the egg-wash seal contain egg.
storage: The filling keeps chilled for a day ahead; serve the cooked ravioli hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
